D: Three witch sisters are brought back to life in Salem on Halloween night.
P: Serve the mains when the witches take over the town Halloween party.
S: Pretzel rods dipped in green white chocolate with almond nails
Pretzel rods dipped in melted white chocolate tinted green, a flaked almond pressed on the tip as a nail, set on baking paper.
Thackery Binx, cursed to live as a black cat

Crisp black sesame and parmesan crackers cut into cat shapes, with a whipped feta and honey dip for little paws. Rub 80g cold butter into 150g plain flour, 50g grated parmesan, 40g black sesame seeds and half a tsp salt. Add 2 to 3 tbsp cold water to form a dough. Chill 20 minutes, roll 3mm thick and cut out cat shapes. Bake at 180C for 10 to 12 minutes until crisp. Blitz 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and 1 tbsp honey until smooth.
Fried cider doughnut rings rolled in cinnamon sugar
Cake doughnuts made with reduced apple cider and spice, fried at 175C and tossed in cinnamon sugar while warm.
M: Lamb shoulder braised with cumin, cinnamon and pumpkin, over couscous
Lamb shoulder browned, onion, garlic, cumin and cinnamon, stock and tomato, pumpkin added for the last hour, braised 2.5 hours at 160C. Served in a black pot with couscous.
a cold New England Halloween night

Creamy New England chowder of clams, smoky bacon and potato, served in crusty bread bowls with chives and a scatter of oyster crackers. Steam 1kg clams in 125ml white wine, covered, until open, then pick the meat and strain the liquor. Render 150g diced bacon, add 1 onion and 2 celery sticks and cook 6 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then the clam liquor, 500ml milk and 400g diced potato and simmer 15 minutes. Add 200ml cream and the clams and heat through. Hollow 4 round crusty rolls and ladle in. Finish with chives and crackers.
W: Apples dipped in a shiny red hard candy coating
Sugar, water, golden syrup and red colouring boiled to 150C, apples on sticks dipped and twirled, set on oiled baking paper.
K: Lime sorbet, lemonade and pineapple juice punch with gummy worms, no alcohol
Lime sorbet scooped into a punch bowl, topped with lemonade and pineapple juice so it froths, a few gummy worms over the side.

s.note: Pretzel rods dipped in green white chocolate with almond nails
s.how: Melt 200g white chocolate and tint it green. Dip 20 pretzel rods most of the way, then press a flaked almond on the tip of each as a nail. Lay on baking paper to set.

s.note: Fried cider doughnut rings rolled in cinnamon sugar
s.how: Simmer 500ml apple juice down to 125ml. Mix 350g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp cinnamon and 100g sugar, then the cider, 80ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 30g melted butter. Roll 1.5cm thick, cut 12 rings, fry at 175C for 1 minute a side and toss in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon.

m.note: Lamb shoulder braised with cumin, cinnamon and pumpkin, over couscous
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced lamb shoulder. Soften 2 onions with 2 tsp cumin and 1 tsp cinnamon, add 500ml stock and a tin of tomatoes. Braise at 160C for 2.5 hours, adding 600g pumpkin for the last hour. Serve over 300g couscous.

w.note: Apples dipped in a shiny red hard candy coating
w.how: Push sticks into 4 apples. Boil 400g sugar, 125ml water and 2 tbsp golden syrup to 150C, add red colouring and dip and twirl each apple. Set on oiled baking paper until hard.

d.note: Lime sorbet, lemonade and pineapple juice punch with gummy worms, no alcohol
d.how: Scoop 500ml lime sorbet into a punch bowl. Pour over 1L lemonade and 250ml pineapple juice so it froths up. Hang a few gummy worms over the side of the bowl.
